sections.note: Employees data table: [3x1] header row + 2 [3x1] data rows -> table block

proposed_rules.trigger: A template/app-demo page's main content zone renders as an app_id="..." attribute string instead of visible UI, indicating the embedded live Knack app iframe did not render (cross-origin/lazy-load) during capture.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat live-app demo zones consistently as an 'app-demo-embed' block regardless of whether the specific capture rendered full UI or just a leaked attribute string; do not author the raw table data as static default-content since it's sample/demo data. Alternatives considered: import the rendered table verbatim as static content (rejected - it's live sample data (Linda Woodard, Patrick Oliver) tied to a demo app, not editorial copy).
proposed_rules.rationale: Same page-18/page-4 template pair as cluster C63, which shows the identical zone unrendered (just 'app_id=...' text). The two captures of the same template diverge only due to iframe render timing, confirming this is a pipeline capture artifact rather than real content difference.

provenance.evidence: C64 rc1c2c1 fully-rendered dashboard/table vs C63 rc1c2 'app_id=...' placeholder

notes: This capture fully rendered the embedded Knack app demo (import banner + employee data table with sample rows), unlike its sibling cluster C63 where the same template's app embed did not render.
